properties.name: sitmun.module
properties.description: SITMUN module name.

properties.name: sitmun.version
properties.description: SITMUN version.

properties.name: sitmun.language
properties.description: Default language for the application.

properties.name: sitmun.variables.system
properties.description: System variable names to SpEL expressions. Placeholders #{NAME} in proxied SQL/HTTP resolve from user, territory, application, request clock (#now), and locale (#language).

properties.name: sitmun.user.secret
properties.description: Secret key for user authentication.

properties.name: sitmun.user.token-validity-in-milliseconds
properties.description: User session JWT validity duration in milliseconds.

properties.name: sitmun.user.cookie-max-age-in-seconds
properties.description: Max-Age in seconds for viewer and admin session cookies. Must not exceed the user JWT TTL.

properties.name: sitmun.user.max-session-duration-milliseconds
properties.description: Hard cap from auth_time after which POST /api/authenticate/refresh is refused.

properties.name: sitmun.mobile.token-validity-in-milliseconds
properties.description: Mobile edition access token validity duration in milliseconds.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy-middleware.secret
properties.description: Secret key for proxy middleware authentication.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy-middleware.config-response-validity-in-seconds
properties.description: Configuration response validity duration in seconds.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy-middleware.force
properties.description: Force proxy middleware usage.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy-middleware.url
properties.description: Proxy middleware URL.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy.url
properties.description: Proxy URL.

properties.name: sitmun.backend.url
properties.description: Backend URL.

properties.name: sitmun.client.unsafe-allowed-hosts
properties.description: List of hosts allowed for unsafe connections.

properties.name: sitmun.authentication.ldap.url
properties.description: LDAP server URL.

properties.name: sitmun.authentication.ldap.base-dn
properties.description: LDAP base DN.

properties.name: sitmun.authentication.ldap.user-dn-pattern
properties.description: LDAP user DN pattern.

properties.name: sitmun.authentication.ldap.password
properties.description: LDAP password.

properties.name: sitmun.recover-password.front.url
properties.description: Frontend URL for password recovery.

properties.name: sitmun.recover-password.mail.from
properties.description: Email sender address for password recovery.

properties.name: sitmun.recover-password.jwt.token-recovery-password-validity-in-milliseconds
properties.description: JWT token validity for password recovery in milliseconds.

properties.name: sitmun.ui.image.supported-formats
properties.description: Supported image formats for UI (png, jpg, jpeg, svg). SVG is stored as a data URI without raster scaling.

properties.name: sitmun.ui.image.default-width
properties.description: Default image width.

properties.name: sitmun.ui.image.default-height
properties.description: Default image height.

properties.name: sitmun.ui.image.sizes
properties.description: Image size configurations.

properties.name: sitmun.dashboard.fetch-metrics
properties.description: Dashboard metrics fetch interval.

properties.name: sitmun.dashboard.initial-delay
properties.description: Dashboard initial delay.

properties.name: sitmun.dashboard.cartographies-by-created-date.size
properties.description: Number of days to count cartographies by created date.

properties.name: sitmun.dashboard.cartographies-by-created-date.query
properties.description: Query to count cartographies by created date.

properties.name: sitmun.dashboard.users-by-created-date.size
properties.description: Number of days to count users by created date.

properties.name: sitmun.dashboard.users-by-created-date.query
properties.description: Query to count users by created date.

properties.name: sitmun.dashboard.users-per-application.size
properties.description: Number of days to count users per application.

properties.name: sitmun.dashboard.users-per-application.query
properties.description: Query to count users per application.

properties.name: sitmun.startup.code-lists.check-on-startup
properties.description: Check code lists on startup.

properties.name: sitmun.proxy-middleware.token-validity-in-milliseconds
properties.description: Token validity duration for proxy middleware in milliseconds.

properties.name: sitmun.authentication.oidc.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable OIDC authentication.

properties.name: sitmun.authentication.oidc.providers
properties.description: OIDC providers configuration.

properties.name: sitmun.startup.built-in-users.admin-password
properties.description: Optional bootstrap password used only to create a missing built-in admin user or restore an empty admin password at startup. Inject via SITMUN_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD. No default. Remove after /api/dashboard/health is UP and rotate via the admin UI.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.enabled
properties.description: Periodic service-check dispatcher. The access-check button stays available when this is false.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.interval
properties.description: Age after which a service is due for a periodic probe.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.dispatch-interval
properties.description: How often the dispatcher looks for a free slot.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.max-in-flight
properties.description: Probe slots shared by the dispatcher and the access-check button.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.max-per-host
properties.description: In-flight probes per upstream host.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.timeout
properties.description: TimeLimiter duration for one probe. A timed-out call is timeout.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.connect-timeout
properties.description: OkHttp connect timeout for a probe.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.read-timeout
properties.description: OkHttp read timeout for a probe.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.sample-retention
properties.description: Delete check samples older than this.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.usage-retention
properties.description: Delete usage rows older than this.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.retention-interval
properties.description: How often retention runs.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.overdue-warn-factor
properties.description: Log when the oldest due age reaches this multiple of interval.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.viewer-flush-interval
properties.description: Flush in-memory viewer configuration counters.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.detail-max-length
properties.description: Cut the stored detail line.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.exception-text-max-length
properties.description: Cut OGC exception text before the captures see it.

properties.name: sitmun.service-check.scan-max-bytes
properties.description: Maximum bytes passed into the shared StAX scan.
